# Deep Learning Journey

A hands-on journey into **Deep Learning and Artificial Intelligence**, documenting my learning progress through practical implementations, experiments, and real-world projects using Python, TensorFlow, and Keras.

This repository contains my implementations of fundamental neural networks and modern deep learning architectures, ranging from Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) to Transformers.

My focus is on understanding the underlying concepts, implementing models from scratch where possible, experimenting with different architectures, and applying deep learning techniques to practical problems.

## 🧠 Projects

This repository contains practical implementations of different deep learning architectures.

### 1. Artificial Neural Network (ANN)

**Project: Iris Flower Classification**

- Implemented an Artificial Neural Network for multiclass classification.
- Explored input, hidden, and output layers.
- Applied activation functions and backpropagation.
- Evaluated classification performance.

📌 [Explore ANN Projects](ANN/README.md)

### 2. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)

**Project: Handwritten Digit Recognition**

- Explored Perceptron, ANN, and CNN architectures.
- Implemented convolution and pooling operations.
- Applied CNNs to image classification.
- Evaluated model performance on handwritten digits.

📌 [Explore CNN Projects](CNN/README.md)

### 3. Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)

**Project: Next Word Prediction and Text Generation using LSTM**

- Explored sequential data processing.
- Implemented an LSTM-based language model.
- Applied tokenization and sequence generation.
- Developed a next-word prediction system.

📌 [Explore RNN Projects](RNN/README.md)

### 4. Transformer

**Project: Movie Review Sentiment Classification**

- Implemented a custom Transformer Encoder architecture using TensorFlow and Keras.
- Applied token embedding and positional embedding.
- Explored multi-head self-attention.
- Implemented residual connections and layer normalization.
- Built a binary sentiment classification model using the IMDB dataset.
- Achieved **85.50% test accuracy** and **0.9328 ROC-AUC** in the recorded experiment.

📌 [Explore Transformer Projects](Transformer/README.md)

## 📚 Learning Roadmap

My Deep Learning learning journey covers the following topics.

### 1. Neural Network Fundamentals

- Biological Neuron vs. Artificial Neuron
- Perceptron
- Activation Functions
- Forward Propagation
- Loss Functions
- Backpropagation
- Gradient Descent
- Optimization Algorithms

### 2. Artificial Neural Networks (ANN)

- ANN Architecture
- Input, Hidden, and Output Layers
- Weights and Biases
- Model Compilation
- Model Training
- Model Evaluation
- Overfitting and Underfitting
- Regularization Techniques
- Dropout
- Early Stopping

### 3. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)

- Convolution Operation
- Filters and Feature Maps
- Padding and Stride
- Pooling Layers
- Flattening
- CNN Architecture
- Image Classification
- Transfer Learning

### 4. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN)

- Sequential Data
- Recurrent Neural Network
- Vanishing Gradient Problem
- Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)
- Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)
- Time Series Prediction
- Sequence Modeling
- Next Word Prediction
- Text Generation

### 5. Transformers

- Attention Mechanism
- Scaled Dot-Product Attention
- Self-Attention
- Multi-Head Attention
- Positional Encoding and Embeddings
- Encoder and Decoder Architecture
- Transformer Architecture
- Masked Attention
- Teacher Forcing
- Autoregressive Decoding
- Introduction to Large Language Models (LLMs)

## Goals & Objectives

My goal is to build a strong foundation in Deep Learning and Artificial Intelligence through continuous learning and practical implementation.

I aim to:

- Understand the mathematical and theoretical foundations of deep learning.
- Implement neural network architectures and algorithms.
- Develop practical projects to solve real-world problems.
- Explore research papers and reproduce published implementations.
- Improve model performance through experimentation and optimization.
- Explore modern AI architectures, including Transformers and Large Language Models.
- Prepare for advanced research and future opportunities in AI/ML engineering.
